initial.name: read_file
initial.description: Read a UTF-8 file within the selected workspace.

initial.name: write_file
initial.description: Create or replace a UTF-8 file within the selected workspace.

initial.name: job_output
initial.description: Read retained live or final background job output and status; optionally wait for completion.

initial.name: job_list
initial.description: List background jobs owned by this Agent.

initial.name: job_kill
initial.description: Request cancellation of one background job owned by this Agent.

initial.name: send_message
initial.description: Send a message to your direct continuable child, or to your direct parent when you are a resident continuable child. Running children receive steering at their nearest step; idle or closed children resume a turn. This returns delivery confirmation, independently of any answer.

initial.name: interrupt_agent
initial.description: Request cancellation of a live descendant's current turn. Unclaimed input remains parked until another send_message; owned descendants keep running. An absent target is an accepted no-op.

initial.name: list_agents
initial.description: List your continuable subagents by durable id and label. Status is running for current work, idle for a resident Agent between turns, and ready for a closed resumable Session. Descendants traverses ordinary Sessions and one-shot children in stable pre-order, adding parent and depth. Only direct children may receive send_message; deeper entries are interruption candidates. Listing grants no control permission. Unreadable children are diagnostics.

scope.description: children (default) or the complete descendant tree.

initial.name: subagent
initial.description: Delegate one task to a fresh child without your conversation. This call waits for its final result and cleanup.

initial.name: workflow
initial.description: Run a foreground JavaScript workflow body with top-level await and return JSON. Hooks: agent(prompt, {schema?, label?, phase?, provider?, model?}), parallel(thunks), pipeline(items, ...stages), phase(title), log(message), args. Child failures become null; invalid options, unsupported schemas and resource caps fail the run. No filesystem, network, timers or Node APIs are provided. The worker is containment, not a security boundary.

initial.name: read
initial.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

initial.name: read_image
initial.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. The current model must declare image input.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

initial.name: write
initial.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

initial.name: edit
initial.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend.

old_string.description: Literal text to replace. Must match exactly.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.
